name: CSC ROBO Drillcorpio D3 drilling and anchor robot
summary: Automatic drilling and anchor installation robot for walls and ceilings with built-in dust vacuuming. Made in Hong Kong by CSC ROBO; the data below come from its Singapore partner page.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found. CSC ROBO (Hong Kong Science Park) takes enquiries by email; a Singapore firm, Shiftectonics, presents the D3 on its own site.
